summary: Gateway request fails when the payload omits a model ID
description:
**Selected repository:** https://github.com/example-org/model-service (component mapping).

**Symptom:** A request without model_id returns HTTP 500. The traceback points to gateway_payload/handler.py in https://github.com/example-org/gateway-payload, where parse_request reads payload['model_id'] without checking whether it exists.

**Expected behavior:** Return HTTP 400 with a missing-model-ID error.

**Repository evidence:** model-service deploys the example-org/gateway-payload image. There is no gateway_payload package in model-service.

**Steps to reproduce:** Send POST /infer with JSON body {} to the deployed gateway.
